query: LG colorGamut Auto requested versus Wide readback during calibration
conclusion: Not established as aliases. LG distinguishes the settings; LUT/reset transitions can bypass menu controls. Exact Auto-to-Wide is a user-requested warning policy, not a claim of colorimetric equivalence.

results.finding: Auto tracks the input signal, while Extended/Wide expand color.
Unity LUT upload can bypass gamut controls; behavior varies with model and LUT path. A 1D-only operation is not sufficient proof of gamut bypass.
1D greyscale and 3D gamut calibration are separate; calibration mode is disabled before final readings.
